tables.name: hand_offs
tables.description: An alert that hands something to a person (S13-29 rules 53 to 57: 'a person' means the owner, or whoever they named): who was told, why, about which booking or safety read, and the deadline after which Rosie's team steps in. Who is told (arch 06 line 329): crisis words, the owner and Rosie's team at once; an emergency or a threat, the owner, then after 5 minutes with no reply or console tap whoever they named and Rosie's team; any other hand-off, the owner in text hours, then after 2 days unanswered Rosie's team (S11-19). The alert itself is a core outbox row; the page to the team is a team_pages row that points here. Harm to a child or older adult, and a report about the owner or staff, never go to the owner: they are K-34 harm reports and page the team directly.
tables.source: arch 06 line 329; S13-29 rules 53, 54, 57; S11-19 ('Still no answer after 2 days, or word that Sam can't act or may have died: Rosie's team checks first'); S13-10; A3-25; A3-48; 02-contracts section 7 row K-36 ('owner alerts and hand-offs (S11-19)')

columns.name: id
columns.description: The hand-off's id: an opaque string code makes and never parses (CQ-09).
columns.source: CQ-09 (other ids are opaque strings)

columns.name: business_id
columns.description: The business whose owner is told (businesses.id). Row-level security scopes by it.
columns.source: arch 06 line 329 ('the owner'); arch 10 line 546

columns.name: kind
columns.description: Which row of arch 06 line 329's 'Who is told' it follows: crisis_words (the owner and Rosie's team at once); emergency or threat (the owner; after 5 minutes with no reply or console tap, whoever they named and Rosie's team, paged every 5 minutes until acknowledged); other (any other hand-off: the owner in text hours; unanswered for 2 days, Rosie's team).
columns.source: arch 06 line 329; S13-29 rule 57; S11-19

columns.name: safety_outcome_id
columns.description: For crisis_words, emergency and threat, the safety read that raised it (safety_outcomes.id, K-34 v1); null for other. The person's words stay sealed there: the owner hears 'Urgent: a customer may need help', never the words.
columns.source: arch 06 line 329; A3-25; K-34 v1 safety_outcomes

columns.name: turn_id
columns.description: The turn whose one commit handed it off (turns.id); null when a clock or a job handed it off.
columns.source: arch 02 line 121 (one commit per turn)

columns.name: booking_id
columns.description: The booking it is about (bookings.id), or null.
columns.source: S13-29 rules 53, 54; S13-10 ('Crisis words after booking')

columns.name: about_person_id
columns.description: The person it is about (persons.id), such as the customer whose text was read, when known.
columns.source: S13-29 rule 53; FS line 743

columns.name: told_person_id
columns.description: Who was told (persons.id): the owner, or whoever the owner named to stand for them (S13-29 rule 57).
columns.source: S13-29 rule 57 ('"A person" means the owner, or whoever they named'); arch 06 line 329

columns.name: told_as
columns.description: owner, or named (whoever the owner named). Who the owner names is K-22's (not yet frozen); this row copies the person told.
columns.source: S13-29 rule 57

columns.name: alert_outbox_row_id
columns.description: The alert sent to the person told (outbox_rows.id), written in the same commit; send class safety for crisis_words, emergency and threat, routine (held for text hours) for other. Null when no outbox row is linked, such as a hand-off seen only on the owner console; code links the row (README rule 5).
columns.source: arch 01 line 65; RULES 4.3; arch 06 line 329 ('the owner in text hours')

columns.name: summary
columns.description: What is handed off, in plain words with no private value: for a safety read only what the owner may hear ('Urgent: a customer may need help'), never the person's words, which stay sealed in K-34.
columns.source: A3-25; S13-10 ('never the words'); RULES 4.5; K-37 v1 README rule 4 (no private value in a plain column)

columns.name: handed_at
columns.description: When it was handed off (the commit that wrote it).
columns.source: arch 06 line 329 ('at once')

columns.name: escalate_at
columns.description: When Rosie's team (and, for an emergency or a threat, whoever the owner named) is paged if nobody has answered: at handed_at for crisis_words (at once); 5 minutes after handed_at for emergency and threat; for other, 2 days after the owner is told in text hours, so never sooner than 2 days after handed_at. Code computes it.
columns.source: arch 06 line 329 ('after 5 minutes with no reply or console tap'; 'unanswered for 2 days, Rosie's team'); S11-19

columns.name: escalation_clock_row_id
columns.description: The core clock row that pages Rosie's team at escalate_at (clock_rows.id); null for crisis_words, which pages at once. Cancelled when an answer comes first.
columns.source: arch 01 line 83; arch 10 line 540 (every clock is a PostgreSQL row); K-04 v1 clock_rows

columns.name: answered_at
columns.description: When the person told answered, by a reply or a console tap; null while unanswered.
columns.source: arch 06 line 329 ('no reply or console tap')

columns.name: answered_via
columns.description: reply (a text or email reply) or console_tap (a tap on the owner console).
columns.source: arch 06 line 329 ('no reply or console tap')

columns.name: answered_by_person_id
columns.description: Who answered (persons.id).
columns.source: arch 06 line 329; S13-29 rule 57

columns.name: escalated_at
columns.description: When it went to Rosie's team: the team_pages row that points here was opened. Null while it has not.
columns.source: arch 06 line 329; S11-19; S13-29 rule 57 ('If they can't be reached in time ... Rosie's team steps in')

columns.name: version
columns.description: The row's version: every update raises it by one, and a commit compares and sets it, so a write made from an old read is refused with the rows that changed (limit 4).
columns.source: arch 01 line 85; arch 10 line 506; K-04 v1 rule 2

unique.name: hand_offs_clock_key
unique.source: arch 01 line 83 (one clock row per clock)

checks.name: hand_offs_kind_known
checks.expression: kind in ('crisis_words', 'emergency', 'threat', 'other')

checks.name: hand_offs_told_as_known
checks.expression: told_as in ('owner', 'named')

checks.name: hand_offs_safety_kind_has_outcome
checks.expression: (kind = 'other') = (safety_outcome_id is null)
checks.source: arch 06 line 329 (crisis words, an emergency and a threat are safety outcomes); K-34 v1 safety_outcomes

checks.name: hand_offs_crisis_words_at_once
checks.expression: kind <> 'crisis_words' or escalate_at = handed_at
checks.source: arch 06 line 329 ('crisis words, Rosie's team and the owner at once')

checks.name: hand_offs_emergency_threat_five_minutes
checks.expression: kind not in ('emergency', 'threat') or escalate_at = handed_at + interval '5 minutes'
checks.source: arch 06 line 329 ('after 5 minutes with no reply or console tap')

checks.name: hand_offs_other_two_days
checks.expression: kind <> 'other' or escalate_at >= handed_at + interval '2 days'
checks.source: arch 06 line 329 ('the owner in text hours; unanswered for 2 days, Rosie's team'); S11-19

checks.name: hand_offs_clock_unless_at_once
checks.expression: (kind = 'crisis_words') = (escalation_clock_row_id is null)

checks.name: hand_offs_answered_via_known
checks.expression: answered_via is null or answered_via in ('reply', 'console_tap')
checks.source: arch 06 line 329 ('no reply or console tap')

checks.name: hand_offs_answered_together
checks.expression: (answered_at is null) = (answered_via is null) and (answered_at is null) = (answered_by_person_id is null)

checks.name: hand_offs_answered_after_handed
checks.expression: answered_at is null or answered_at >= handed_at

checks.name: hand_offs_escalated_when_due

indexes.name: hand_offs_waiting_idx
indexes.where: answered_at is null and escalated_at is null
indexes.why: Hand-offs nobody has answered yet, due to go to Rosie's team (arch 06 line 329; S11-19).

indexes.name: hand_offs_business_handed_idx
indexes.why: A business's hand-offs, newest first, for the owner console and the owner's answer (arch 06 line 329).

indexes.name: hand_offs_safety_outcome_idx
indexes.why: The hand-off a safety read raised (K-34 v1 safety_outcomes).

tables.name: team_pages
tables.description: A page to Rosie's team and its acknowledgement: what it is about (a hand-off nobody answered in time, crisis words, word that the owner can't act, a harm report, a review item, a missed safety check, a reply that went out as 'I've passed this on', a hard-invariant breach), when it was opened, how many times it was paged, whether it repeats every 5 minutes until acknowledged, and who acknowledged it, how and when. For an emergency or a threat, whoever the owner named is paged with the team. Rosie's team's rows: the Tool API role may add them and never read, change or delete them (README rule 2).
tables.source: arch 06 line 329 ('paged every 5 minutes until acknowledged (DD)'); arch 02 diagram line 105 ('Team console · paging · gap cases · dead letters'); arch 03 line 123 ('the team is paged'); arch 08 line 447 ('A hard-invariant breach in production pages Rosie's team at once'); S11-19; S13-10; B8-86; A3-49; Q-18; 02-contracts section 7 row K-36 ('pages to Rosie's team with their acknowledgement')

columns.name: id
columns.description: The page's id: an opaque string code makes and never parses (CQ-09).
columns.source: CQ-09 (other ids are opaque strings)

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why the team is paged: hand_off (a hand_offs row: crisis words at once, an emergency or a threat after 5 minutes, any other hand-off after 2 days); owner_cannot_act (word that the owner can't act or may have died: S11-19, S13-29 rule 57); harm_report (a K-34 harm report, that day); review_item (a K-37 review item); safety_timer_missed (a K-34 safety timer missed, which the team keeps trying until SAFE); passed_on (a reply that went out as 'I've passed this on. Rosie's team will reply within 1 business day.'); hard_invariant_breach (in production, at once).
columns.source: arch 06 line 329; S11-19; S13-29 rule 57; A3-49; S13-10 ('Nobody reached: Rosie's team keeps trying them'); B8-86; arch 03 line 123; arch 08 line 447

columns.name: business_id
columns.description: The business it is about (businesses.id), or null for one about no single business, such as a hard-invariant breach. Not a row-level security scope: no business reads these rows (README rule 2).
columns.source: arch 06 line 329; arch 08 line 447

columns.name: hand_off_id
columns.description: For hand_off, the hand-off it escalates (hand_offs.id); a hand-off escalates once.
columns.source: arch 06 line 329; S11-19

columns.name: harm_report_id
columns.description: For harm_report, the report (harm_reports.id, K-34 v1), which Rosie's team follows up that day.
columns.source: A3-49; S13-10; arch 06 line 329; K-34 v1 harm_reports

columns.name: review_item_id
columns.description: For review_item, the item in the team review queue (review_items.id, K-37 v1).
columns.source: K-37 v1 review_items; S11-70; Q-18

columns.name: safety_timer_id
columns.description: For safety_timer_missed, the missed check-out timer (safety_timers.id, K-34 v1): a missed check stays open until the pro replies SAFE, and the team keeps trying the pro, the contact and the owner.
columns.source: S13-10 ('Then Rosie's team keeps trying them all'); B8-86; K-34 v1 safety_timers

columns.name: turn_id
columns.description: The turn the page is about or whose commit opened it (turns.id): for passed_on, the turn whose reply went out as 'I've passed this on'; otherwise null when a clock, a job or the release monitor opened it.
columns.source: arch 03 line 123; arch 02 line 121

columns.name: named_person_id
columns.description: Whoever the owner named, paged with the team for an emergency or a threat (persons.id); null when the owner named nobody, or for any other reason. Who the owner names is K-22's (not yet frozen); this row copies the person paged.
columns.source: arch 06 line 329 ('whoever they named and Rosie's team, paged every 5 minutes'); S13-29 rule 57; S13-10 ('So are the owner and whoever they named')

columns.name: summary
columns.description: What the team needs to know, in plain words with no private value: ids and kinds, never a person's words. The words stay sealed in the row it points at.
columns.source: RULES 4.5; arch 09 line 492; K-37 v1 README rule 4 (no private value in a plain column)

columns.name: opened_at
columns.description: When the page was opened and first sent.
columns.source: arch 06 line 329; arch 08 line 447 ('at once')

columns.name: last_paged_at
columns.description: When it was last paged; opened_at for the first page.
columns.source: arch 06 line 329 ('paged every 5 minutes until acknowledged')

columns.name: times_paged
columns.description: How many times it has been paged, the first included. Each page reaches every member on team_page_recipients (removed_at null) and the named person, through core outbox rows.
columns.source: arch 06 line 329

columns.name: repeat_minutes
columns.description: 5 when the page repeats every 5 minutes until acknowledged (arch 06 line 329's emergency and threat row, a DD); null when it is paged once and waits in the team console. Which other reasons repeat is not in the sources (README open gaps).
columns.source: arch 06 line 329 ('paged every 5 minutes until acknowledged (DD)')

columns.name: next_page_clock_row_id
columns.description: The core clock row that sends the next page (clock_rows.id), while a repeating page is open. A clock row fires once, so each page arms a new row and this column moves to it; acknowledging cancels it.
columns.source: arch 01 line 83; arch 10 line 540; K-04 v1 clock_rows; 02-contracts K-05 item 5 (fired once)

columns.name: state
columns.description: open (not yet acknowledged; a repeating page keeps paging) or acknowledged.
columns.source: arch 06 line 329 ('until acknowledged')

columns.name: acknowledged_at
columns.description: When a person paged acknowledged it; paging stops.
columns.source: arch 06 line 329 ('until acknowledged')

columns.name: acknowledged_by_person_id
columns.description: Who acknowledged it (persons.id): a person on Rosie's team (Jay and the CTO until launch, Q-18), or whoever the owner named.
columns.source: arch 06 line 329; Q-18; S13-29 rule 57

columns.name: acknowledged_via
columns.description: reply (a reply to the page) or console_tap (a tap in the team console).
columns.source: arch 06 line 329 ('reply or console tap'); arch 02 diagram line 105 (team console · paging)

columns.name: version
columns.description: The row's version: every update raises it by one, and a commit compares and sets it, so a write made from an old read is refused with the rows that changed (limit 4).
columns.source: arch 01 line 85; arch 10 line 506; K-04 v1 rule 2

unique.name: team_pages_one_per_hand_off
unique.source: arch 06 line 329 (a hand-off goes to Rosie's team once, then is paged until acknowledged)

unique.name: team_pages_clock_key
unique.source: arch 01 line 83 (one clock row per clock)

checks.name: team_pages_owner_cannot_act_has_business

checks.name: team_pages_named_only_for_hand_off

checks.source: arch 06 line 329 (an emergency or a threat: whoever they named and Rosie's team)

checks.name: team_pages_repeat_every_five
checks.expression: repeat_minutes is null or repeat_minutes = 5
checks.source: arch 06 line 329 ('paged every 5 minutes until acknowledged (DD)')

checks.name: team_pages_times_paged
checks.expression: times_paged >= 1 and (times_paged = 1 or repeat_minutes is not null)

checks.name: team_pages_last_paged_in_order

checks.name: team_pages_state_known
checks.expression: state in ('open', 'acknowledged')

checks.name: team_pages_acknowledged_via_known
checks.expression: acknowledged_via is null or acknowledged_via in ('reply', 'console_tap')
checks.source: arch 06 line 329 ('reply or console tap'); arch 02 diagram line 105

checks.name: team_pages_acknowledged_together
checks.expression: (state = 'acknowledged') = (acknowledged_at is not null) and (acknowledged_at is null) = (acknowledged_by_person_id is null) and (acknowledged_at is null) = (acknowledged_via is null)

checks.name: team_pages_acknowledged_after_paged
checks.expression: acknowledged_at is null or acknowledged_at >= last_paged_at
checks.source: arch 06 line 329 ('paged ... until acknowledged': no page after the acknowledgement)

rowLevelSecurity.why: Rosie's team's rows, never a business's: a page may point at a harm report that names the owner or staff, who must never hear of it (S13-10; arch 06 line 329), or at a review item the business must not see (K-37 v1 README rule 2). The Tool API role may insert only (README rule 2); the team's side reads, repeats and acknowledges unscoped.

tables.name: team_page_recipients
tables.description: The members of Rosie's team who get every page, and how each is reached: in their own open chat with Rosie, else by email, since Rosie never writes first (C9). Until launch the members are Jay and the CTO (Q-18); on staging, only roster test phones and the test console (BP 9.4). A member leaves the list by removed_at, never by a delete. Rosie's team's rows: the Tool API role has no grant on them (README rule 2).
tables.source: QUESTIONS.md M3-M3b.5 (default: 'The architect adds a recipient list to K-36. Each member gets pages in their own open chat with Rosie, else by email. Until launch the members are Jay and the CTO (Q-18). On staging, only roster test phones and the test console (BP 9.4)'); Q-18; MC C9; arch 06 line 329
